explanation: The central figure in Christianity who, according to the Bible, is God's Son and the Savior of humanity.
The term Jesus uses for God, emphasizing a personal and close relationship between the Creator and believers.
The Holy Spirit, described in the chapter as the Comforter or Guide who will be with the disciples after Jesus has departed.
A term used by Jesus to describe the only way to God the Father, which he identifies himself as ("I am the way").
Refers to God's dwelling in heaven where Jesus promises to prepare a place for his disciples.
The meaning of the word "Paraclete" (comforter), a title for the Holy Spirit who will give strength and guidance when Jesus is no longer physically present.
The inner calm and security that Jesus leaves to his disciples, which he says differs from the world's concept of peace.
